annual_rate.notes: For judgments governed by 12 O.S. §727.1, the 2026 post-judgment rate is 8.75%. The annual formula uses the prime rate listed in the first Wall Street Journal edition published for the calendar year plus two percentage points. The statute uses simple interest and supplies a separate formula for qualifying prejudgment interest. Another controlling law or judgment category can require a different rule. Verify applicability; not legal advice.
